environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No reverse proxy, no WAF. The application serves HTML directly from Express on port 4000. Session tokens are long-lived (3600s). No Content-Security-Policy headers configured. The /posts/:postId/comments endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication.
